## 1. Architectural Mission
module_id: "mod_security_zero_trust_and_mtls"

## 2. Invariant Checklist
- **Never Trust, Always Verify**: Every single API request, gRPC invocation, and intra-service packet is explicitly authenticated, authorized, and encrypted—regardless of whether it originates outside the cloud or inside the Kubernetes cluster.
- **Workload Identity & Mutual TLS (SPIFFE/SPIRE)**: Every microservice and batch worker receives an ephemeral cryptographic X.509 SVID (SPIFFE Verifiable Identity Document), rotated automatically every 60 minutes via SPIRE daemons. Enforces bidirectional mTLS encryption and identity attestation.
- **Sub-Millisecond Distributed Revocation (Redis Bloom Filter)**: High-speed distributed token revocation layer checking active session IDs (`jti`) against an in-memory Bloom filter with $\le 200\mu\text{s}$ evaluation latency, eradicating the vulnerability window of stolen JWT tokens.
- **Institutional Four-Eyes Principle (Dual-Control State Machine)**: Cryptographic multi-signature protocol requiring two distinct authorized actors before state-altering actions (e.g. promoting production pricing models, overriding risk limits, or altering security policies) can execute.
- QuantLib API Gateway: `spiffe://nb.enterprise/ns/finance/sa/mod_quantlib_api`
- Numerical Core Compute Enclave: `spiffe://nb.enterprise/ns/finance/sa/mod_quantlib_core`
- TimescaleDB & DuckDB Persistence Service: `spiffe://nb.enterprise/ns/finance/sa/mod_quantlib_db`
- Accounting Subledger Worker: `spiffe://nb.enterprise/ns/finance/sa/mod_quantlib_accounting`
- name: internal_grpc_listener
- transport_socket:
- certificate_chain: { filename: "/run/spire/certs/svid.pem" }
- sanitizer:
- name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
- name: local_service
- match: { prefix: "/quantlib.v1.QuantLibPricingService/" }
